_comment: Categories added by rule, whatever the model answers.
board: a member of doValue's management named in the subject, the email text, an attachment, or the To/Cc
addresses makes the email a 'Διοίκηση' one; it becomes the main request (Priority 1). Names match whole words
with Greek case endings ignored (Πανούσης = κ. Πανούση). Titles are matched the same way.
documents: an attachment of one of these document types (core/attachment_processor.py DOCUMENT_TYPES) adds
the category as a request, unless the attachment was judged irrelevant to the email.
